title: lore agent context auto-pins the bundle's Constitution into every profile's pack (OPAG-425 R8, LCLI-597 AC3 option B)
description: Ruled by opum-agent 2026-09-26T22:00:21Z (recorded in opum-doc Constitution/Constants ADR Amendment 4, f3f12e7). LCLI-597 AC3 said "lore init default .lore/agents profiles pin the Constitution", but lore init writes no agent profiles: nothing in src/ writes .lore/agents, and a default pin would fail lore check on a fresh init that has no Constitution. Option B was ruled instead: when the bundle has a Constitution (built-in type, not a profile-declared one, per R12), lore agent context adds it to every profile pack as a pinned source. When there is none it pins nothing and errors nothing. No new lore init output and no default profiles. Pack contents change additively; note that in the CHANGELOG.

acceptanceCriteria.text: With a built-in Constitution present, lore agent context <profile> for every profile carries it as a pinned source; with none present, packs are byte-identical to today, proven by tests including a positive control
A profile-declared Constitution (R12) is not auto-pinned, and an explicit pin of the same document is not duplicated
CHANGELOG notes the additive pack change; bun test and bun run lore check exit 0
